comments.body:
Proposal for the `peerdas-devnet-4` reset:

Use the exact same configuration, but:
1. Run only with 3/5 of the nodes (not enough to finalize). Wait for 24H, then
2. Sync 1/5 of the nodes from genesis (4/5 of the nodes are now up). The network should now finalize. Wait for 24, then
3. Sync the remaining 1/5 of the nodes.

`2.` will test Debeb->Electra->Fulu in an unfinalized network.
`3.` will test Debeb->Electra->Fulu in a finalized network.

Just want to surface these - validator custody design docs, keen to hear if anyone has thoughts:
- Manu: https://hackmd.io/@manunalepa/B1xJs2e5ke
- Lion: https://hackmd.io/@dapplion/validator_custody_no_backfill
- @ethDreamer also brought up a good point that we need to let peers know when CGC changes, i.e. need to make sure we bump the `metadata.seq_number` after updating CGC.

**Move proof computation to transaction sender** (needs a shorter name 😅  ) - there's active discussion on #allcoredevs: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/1340931845239341087

We can probably continue the async discussion, unless anyone wants to bring up any specific points, but if there are EL devs on the call, we can probably discuss the plan forward.

> * Lion: https://hackmd.io/@dapplion/validator_custody_no_backfill
> * [@ethDreamer](https://github.com/ethDreamer) also brought up a good point that we need to let peers know when CGC changes, i.e. need to make sure we bump the `metadata.seq_number` after updating CGC.

is it a crazy idea to have the channels and the length of history (in days  or hours maybe?) so that we could at least understand they've got all the history for N days while it builds up? Then you'd be able to have a good view of what the node should be able to provide even though we're not backfilling... I'm definitely no authority on ENR so may be a silly question...
